summary:
PASS — supersede round-trip verified end-to-end via MCP only (no direct graph writes). Exercised BOTH supersede entry points:

(1) Integrated path — record_decision(supersedes:) chained ZQX-7741 original→replacement; response returned superseded.old_key + changeover ts.
(2) Standalone tool — supersede_note(old,new) chained ZQX-7742-A→B directly; the contradiction-detection hint had even pre-suggested the exact call.

Temporal retrieval via search_knowledge verified all three modes correctly:
- default (current-only): returns ONLY the replacement note (superseded note hidden).
- history:true: returns BOTH; old note carries current:false, validTo set, supersededBy=new; new carries supersedes=old, current:true.
- as_of (timestamp before changeover): recovers the OLD fact, confirming bi-temporal as-of retrieval.
Validity continuity confirmed: old.validTo == new.validFrom == the supersede instant, for both chains.

Test-only side effect: 4 throwaway probe notes (ZQX-7741 original/replacement, ZQX-7742-A/B) now live in the KB; harmless but could be pruned if desired.
